summary: A jury finds Thomas Hudson, also known as Doe and Murphy, guilty of attempting to hold up the Silver Bow National Bank; his insanity defence fails and sentencing is left to the court, with up to ten years in the penitentiary possible. Names recovered from the OCR-degraded body include juror John Chatham, defence counsel Mr. Cotter, witness Mr. Booth, Mike Whalen, Officer Allen, Cashier Cutter, and Judges Speer and Knowles.
